review_data: Previously inspected MAiDE-up/Booking/GPT-4 retired as test; grouped by city+hotel across all languages and labels
generator_newness: Gemma family absent from training; Qwen3 checkpoint absent, Qwen family shared with Qwen-Max. Prior Cal5 tasks used these families; no XLM-R training exposure.
checkpoint: Max minimum-language review validation standardized partial ROC-AUC at FPR .05, tie macro review then macro general then earlier; epoch0 may win to avoid forced regression
calibration: Human Booking reviews from held-out hotels; per-language one-sided95% binomial upper FPR bound .05; no external threshold fitting

test.selection: stable hash, no detector scores; human length40..600chars, Chinese20..300; min12letters; audit inherited/development/prior-test exact and near
test.primary: All completed, correct-language, nonidentical AI rewrites; human cohort retained independent of generator failures; explicit language
test.secondary: Common parents across both generators and within-pair length ratio .8..1.25, plus posthoc ROC recall@5% labelled diagnostic not deployable

known_limits: MARC/RuReviews human origin inferred from historical collection, no individual authorship proof
Test covers rewrites by two compact local models, not arbitrary generators
